_comment: Reviewed secret-scan matches in git history that are not credentials for any real system. Matched by commit, file and rule; reported as ACCEPTED. Never add a real credential here: rotate it instead.

history.reason: Former fixed default password for synthetic local seed accounts. Replaced by a random per-seed password (October 2026 review). It protects nothing outside a developer's local stack; any hosted account ever seeded without SEED_PASSWORD must have its password reset.
